rules.description: Every shortlisted candidate meets the role's must-haves: both must-have skills, the minimum relevant experience (R1 36 months of software engineering, R2 24 months of data analytics, R3 24 months of information security) and, for R3, a CISSP or CompTIA Security+ certificate on record.

Nobody who needs visa sponsorship is shortlisted for a role that requires existing work authorization: R1 and R3, and R2 too unless it is hired through an employer of record (from medium on); legal requirement.
A candidate appears on at most one role's shortlist.
